findings.message: Glossary RU-name collision: the meeting range input fields are named «Начало встречи — {city}» / «Конец встречи — {city}» (proposal FR3, design D4 i18n keys meeting.rangeInputStartLabel/EndLabel, grid-view delta 'Meeting range input'), but docs/glossary/time-selection.md:25 already assigns *RU:* «Начало встречи» / «Конец встречи» to **Meeting handle** (existing ru.json meeting.startHandle/endHandle). .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'Russian interface text uses the *RU:* name' and each term names one concept; two different controls would share one Russian name. This also makes NFR-A2 and the 'Tab order skips the locked controls' scenario ambiguous: they end with «Начало встречи», «Конец встречи» (the handles in the current spec) while the proposal says the Tab order 'includes the meeting range input'. Give the fields distinct glossary-backed names and state where the open fields sit in the Tab order relative to the handles.

design.md D4 claims the change keeps LocationRow under 200 lines, but LocationRow.tsx is already 199 lines (D1 says so) and D1/D4 add useSortable `disabled`, `isDisabled` for DragHandle and LocationMenu, and onConfirmMeetingRange forwarding with the row id, taking it past 200; no task moves code out of LocationRow. process-invariants.md: 'Target 100–200 lines per file; 300 is a hard cap, used only when splitting would hurt clarity.' Add an extraction step to tasks.md or correct the claim.

findings.message: FR7 and design D5 are not achievable as designed: in Grid the LocationMenu (`fixed z-20`, to become `z-location-menu`) renders inside the row header box, which is `sticky ... z-[2]` / `focus-within:z-[4]` (packages/client/src/views/shared/locationRowVariant.ts:37,67). A sticky element with a z-index creates its own stacking context, so the menu is ranked inside that box (z 2/4 on the page) and will paint BELOW the date bar at the planned `z-page-bar` = 10, contradicting FR7 ('an open location menu still lies above the date bar') and D5's consequence 'an open menu and a dragged row stay above the date bar (FR7)'. D5's rejection of `isolation: isolate` ('the fixed location menu inside the panel would be trapped below the date bar') rests on the same wrong assumption: the menu is already trapped by the sticky header box. No task tests the menu-above-date-bar part of FR7 (5.2 'Rows scroll under the date bar' only checks the calendar and Now buttons). Redesign the layering (e.g. portal the menu, or raise the header box while its menu is open) and add an E2E assertion for it.

Task 4.1 replaces `z-[2]`, `focus-within:z-[4]`, `z-[3]` and `z-10` with tokens but only updates the dialog, MainPage, HourFrame and MeetingFrame tests. Existing tests still assert the old classes: src/views/shared/ViewLocationList.grid.test.tsx:94 (`toHaveClass("z-[2]", "focus-within:z-[4]")`), src/views/grid/MeetingHandle.test.tsx:49 (`"z-[3]"`), src/views/shared/LocationRow.dragging.test.tsx:60 (`"z-10"`). Task 4.3a then runs LocationRow.dragging.test.tsx as an unchanged characterization test expecting a pass, and 4.4 / 6.2 run ViewLocationList.grid.test.tsx and `pnpm test`; all fail, so the tasks are not independently verifiable in the given order. 4.1's grep check excludes `.test.` files and misses this. 4.1 must name and update these three tests.

findings.message: Spec deltas are incomplete: FR1 locks the location menu, the drag handle and the wall-time input in Grid while a meeting range is set, but stable specs that state these controls without exception are not MODIFIED. openspec/specs/locations/spec.md:965 'Each card SHALL have a location menu button ... Enter, Space or Arrow Down open it', locations 'Reorder cards by dragging' (:364) and 'Reorder cards with the keyboard' (:409), and openspec/specs/time-selection/spec.md:603 'The time of every location card whose time zone is known ... SHALL be a wall-time input'. After archive they contradict the new grid-view requirement 'Row controls are locked while a meeting range is set'. Add MODIFIED deltas to locations and time-selection that state the Grid meeting-state exception and list them in the proposal's Capabilities section (the proposal already changes the glossary entries Drag handle, Location menu and Wall-time input).

grid-view 'Hour frame lies behind texts' (openspec/specs/grid-view/spec.md:161: 'the city, the offset difference, the zone line, the date, the time and the notes MUST keep their background') is changed by FR8/D6, which removes the background from the zone line container and the time button and keeps it only behind glyphs. The change adds 'Frame lines are visible beside texts' as a new requirement instead of MODIFYing that one, which leaves two overlapping rules about which backgrounds cover the frame.

Task 6.1 limits scoped Stryker to 10 files and skips new or moved logic: the new src/views/shared/wallTimeFieldKeys.ts (key handling moved out of WallTimeInput.tsx), the changed WallTimeInput.tsx, the router in src/model/locations.ts, src/model/reduceWallTime.ts and the new branches in ZoneRowContent.tsx and GridView.tsx. .claude/rules/tdd-workflow.md: 'Run `pnpm run test:mutation` on the changed files'. Add scoped runs (at most 5 files each) for them.
